title.narrative: Output 2.1. Increased capacity of Member States to ratify international labour standards

description.narrative:
The Albanian Parliament ratified the ILO Convention 190 on Eliminating Violence and Harassment in the World of Work on 3 March 2022. It was formally registered by the ILO on 6 May 2022 The ILO supported the constituents in Albania throughout the process which started with the trade unions campaign in support of the new ILO convention since 2018. The ILO provided technical assistance at the numerous trainings and meetings they conducted in various settings to raise the awareness among their members and relevant stakeholders i.e. workers, employers and government representatives including of the Secretariat of the National Labour Council (NCL), the highest social dialogue forum in Albania. The tripartite delegation representing Albania at the Centenary International Labour Conference in July 2019, voted unanimously in favour of the endorsement of the ILO Convention 190. The ILO in cooperation with a prominent gender local expert prepared the C 190 gap analysis with the Albanian legislation. The analysis was validated in a tripartite workshop which acquainted the participants with the C 190, the gaps and the measures that need to be taken for mainstreaming its standard in the relevant domestic laws, the Labour Law, the Occupational Safety and Health law to name a few. In its first meeting in 2020, NCL recommended the Minister of Finance and Economy (in charge of employment and industrial relations) to initiate the procedure for the ratification of C 190. The gap analysis was highly appreciated for the depth of the analysis and the recommendations provided which were the basis for the drafting of the ratification file.
On 8 March 2022, the Speaker of Parliament marked the International Mothers’ Day by launching the news on the ratification of C 190 at a high level meeting with the Albanian Network of Women in Science and high level representatives of social partners. The ILO is supporting the constituents in their efforts to mainstream the C 190 standards in their legal framework and practice.
